skill.description: Guides pymatgen workflows for materials science, including crystal structure analysis, format conversion, phase diagrams, electronic structure review, and Materials Project queries.

skill.author: davila7

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown code fences, Python import examples, placeholders, and documentation URLs. content.value_statement: Materials researchers need reliable help with structure files, phase stability, and pymatgen workflows. This skill guides analysis, conversion, API queries, and practical scripts.
actual_capabilities: Read and explain pymatgen workflows for structures, lattices, molecules, and compositions.
Guide conversion between CIF, POSCAR, XYZ, JSON, YAML, and other supported formats.
Use bundled scripts for structure analysis, format conversion, and phase diagram generation.
Explain symmetry, coordination, distance matrices, density, and lattice properties.
Support Materials Project searches and phase stability analysis with an API key.
Describe VASP, Gaussian, Quantum ESPRESSO, surface, and electronic structure workflows.
limitations: Requires Python, pymatgen, and optional packages such as mp-api for some workflows.
Materials Project features require a valid MP_API_KEY and external API availability.
Does not run DFT, molecular dynamics, or other simulations by itself.
Scientific conclusions depend on input quality, database coverage, and calculation settings.

use_cases.title: Check a Crystal Structure
use_cases.description: Inspect a CIF or POSCAR file for formula, lattice parameters, density, symmetry, and coordination information.

use_cases.title: Prepare Simulation Inputs
use_cases.description: Convert structures and plan VASP or Quantum ESPRESSO workflows using pymatgen input sets and file formats.

use_cases.title: Screen Phase Stability
use_cases.description: Query Materials Project entries, build phase diagrams, and compare candidate compositions against the convex hull.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Structure
prompt_templates.prompt: Use pymatgen to review my structure file. Report formula, lattice parameters, density, symmetry, and any input concerns.

prompt_templates.title: Convert Structure Formats
prompt_templates.prompt: Convert these structure files to POSCAR format and explain any format assumptions or validation checks needed.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Phase Diagram
prompt_templates.prompt: Use Materials Project data to analyze the Li-Fe-O system and explain stable phases, metastable candidates, and decomposition products.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Screening Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a pymatgen workflow to generate doped structures, create VASP inputs, track transformations, and summarize screening outputs.

output_examples.input: A user asks for symmetry and coordination analysis of a POSCAR file.
output_examples.output: A concise report with formula, space group, lattice values, density, site table, and nearest-neighbor coordination notes.

output_examples.input: A user wants a CIF collection converted for VASP calculations.
output_examples.output: A conversion plan with target formats, output naming, validation checks, and warnings for unsupported or malformed files.

output_examples.input: A user asks whether LiFeO2 is stable in the Li-Fe-O system.
output_examples.output: A phase stability summary with hull distance, stable competing phases, decomposition products, and data-source caveats.

best_practices: Validate structures before analysis to catch missing species, bad coordinates, or unrealistic distances.
Use environment variables for API keys and avoid storing credentials in notebooks or shared files.
Record pymatgen versions, transformation steps, and calculation settings for reproducible workflows.
anti_patterns: Do not assume automatic format detection is correct when file extensions or contents are inconsistent.
Do not treat Materials Project results as experimental truth without checking calculation provenance.
Do not overwrite structure files during conversion without keeping the original inputs.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps with pymatgen structure analysis, file conversion, phase diagrams, electronic structure review, and workflow planning.

faq.question: Does it require a Materials Project API key?
faq.answer: Only Materials Project queries and phase diagram scripts require MP_API_KEY. Local structure analysis can work without it.

faq.question: Can it convert CIF files to POSCAR?
faq.answer: Yes. The bundled converter uses pymatgen format support and can handle single files or batches.

faq.question: Can it run VASP calculations?
faq.answer: No. It can prepare inputs and analyze outputs, but it does not execute external simulation software.

faq.question: Which users benefit most?
faq.answer: Materials researchers, computational chemists, and data engineers working with crystal structures benefit most.

faq.question: What should I check before trusting results?
faq.answer: Check input quality, pymatgen version, API data source, convergence status, and assumptions in each analysis step.
